title: A/P Detail: the PDF ends each bucket with its "Total for" row
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have a vendor with an open bill in the "31-60 days past due" bucket and another in the "1-30 days past due" bucket on today's date.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with only that vendor ticked in the Vendor filter, so the PDF holds only those two bills.
custom_steps:
1. Click the chevron button in the table's top-left header cell (Expand all).
  2. Click the ⋯ Export button ("Export report") at the right of the title row.
  3. Click "Download (PDF)".
  4. Open the downloaded PDF.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Every bucket opens.
  • The "31-60 days past due" and "1-30 days past due" buckets each end with a row "Total for " and the bucket's name, with its Amount and Open Balance.

Step 2:

  • The menu shows "Download (PDF)" and "Download (CSV)".

Step 3:

  • A PDF file downloads.

Step 4:

  • The "31-60 days past due" bucket ends with a row that reads "Total for 31-60 days past due", with the same Amount and Open Balance as that row on screen.
  • The "1-30 days past due" bucket ends with a row that reads "Total for 1-30 days past due", with the same Amount and Open Balance as that row on screen.
  • The word "Subtotal" appears nowhere in the PDF.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 13 (13 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 13 Nov 2026, version re-checked 14 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV), story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows)

  • S3-R7b: “In the A/R Detail, A/R Collection, A/P Detail and A/P Unpaid Invoices PDFs, each bucket, customer or vendor ends with a row that reads "Total for <name>", the same words as the screen, for example "Total for 31-60 days past due" or "Total for Acme Towing", with its Amount and Open Balance. A long name wraps inside that row. The PDF never prints "Subtotal".”
  • S3-R1: “Each of the six reports has the native report Export menu (the ⋯ button at the right of the title row, labelled "Export report") with "Download (PDF)" and "Download (CSV)". A/R's former Print button is replaced by this menu. The A/P reports gain a PDF.”
  • S4-R1: “The table's top-left header cell holds one chevron button. While any group is expanded it points down, its tooltip (above the button) reads "Collapse all", and a click collapses every group. When every group is collapsed it points right, its tooltip reads "Expand all", and a click expands every group. The chevron is blue, the same as each group's own chevron (S4-R5).”

Not yet checked against a build: the QA build v26.45.2-6a8b89c exists since 10 Nov 2026 and this case has not been run on it yet.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), version of 5 Nov 2026 (1793886208-34e0), read 10 Nov 2026: page 2 "Export" (board Export.dc.html); page 3 "Collapse all and pinned group rows" (board Grouped.dc.html).
